name: Cerebras
description: Cerebras provides ultra-fast AI inference and training through its wafer-scale chip architecture and cloud platform, supporting leading open-source models.
bestFor: AI researchers training large language models
strengths: World's fastest AI inference, up to 15x faster than GPU-based systems
Wafer-scale architecture unifies compute, memory, and bandwidth on a single chip
OpenAI-compatible API with Python and TypeScript SDKs
Supports models from leading open-source families including Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek
gettingStarted: Generate an API key from the Cerebras platform
Make your first API call using the OpenAI-compatible endpoint
usageNotes: Cerebras Inference offers a free trial with $5 in credits after account creation
Developer tier pay-per-token pricing starts at $0.35 per million input tokens and $0.75 per million output tokens for GPT OSS 120B
Playground allows testing models and prompts directly in the browser without code
Supports tool/function calling, structured outputs, and streaming responses
Available through partner clouds including AWS Marketplace and Hugging Face
priceDetails: Free tier with $5 credits; Developer tier pay-per-token from $0.35/M input tokens; Pro $50/month; Enterprise custom pricing

name: Windsurf
description: An agentic AI-powered IDE developed by Codeium, featuring the Cascade AI assistant for deep codebase context awareness, multi-file editing, and task execution .
bestFor: Developers seeking an AI-first IDE experience with an integrated agentic assistant
Teams wanting a collaborative AI coding environment with centralized billing
Users who prefer a visual editor over a terminal-based workflow
Developers working on context-heavy tasks requiring persistent awareness across sessions
strengths: Cascade agentic system providing real-time awareness and 'Flows' for persistent context
Automatic rule discovery and memory system for customizing AI behavior
Largest free tier among comparable AI coding tools
Integration of Devin's capabilities, such as DeepWiki for codebase understanding
gettingStarted: Navigate to the official Windsurf website and download the installer for your platform (e.g., Windows, macOS)
Install and launch the Windsurf IDE
Open a project or create a new one
Press Cmd/Ctrl+L or click the Cascade icon to open the AI assistant panel
usageNotes: Cascade offers three primary modes: 'Code' for autonomous changes, 'Plan' for multi-step planning, and 'Ask' for read-only analysis
Pricing is subscription-based with a quota system that replaced monthly credits. Free, Pro ($20/month), Teams ($40/seat/month), and Max ($200/month) plans are available
Quotas refresh daily/weekly, and unlimited Tab autocomplete does not consume quota
The tool is a proprietary standalone IDE, not a VS Code fork, so it has a smaller extension ecosystem
Features like Memories and Rules allow for persistent customization and context

name: Google Antigravity
description: Google's agent-first software development platform that evolved from an AI-powered IDE to an orchestration suite for managing autonomous AI agents, including a desktop app, CLI, and SDK .
bestFor: Building and managing AI agents for software development
Developers wanting to orchestrate multi-agent workflows
Developers seeking an agentic coding tool integrated with Google's ecosystem
strengths: Multi-agent parallel orchestration with artifact-based verification
Support for multiple models including Gemini and Claude from the free tier
Deep integration with Google ecosystem (AI Studio, Firebase, Android)
gettingStarted: Download the Google Antigravity desktop application from the official website
Sign in with a Google account
Open an existing project or start a new one in the chat interface
usageNotes: Antigravity CLI (agy) replaces the legacy Gemini CLI
The platform has a free tier with generous limits, but heavier use may require a paid Google AI subscription
The desktop app is a standalone application with a chat-first interface, distinct from the Antigravity IDE
priceDetails: Free tier available; Google AI Pro at $19.99/mo and Google AI Ultra at $100/mo offer increased limits
